title: Can Make Palindrome From Substring
description: Determine if a substring can be rearranged into a palindrome by changing at most k characters.
pseudocode:
1. count = Array(s.length + 1).fill(0)
2. for i = 0 to s.length - 1:
3.   count[i+1] = count[i] ^ (1 << (s[i] - 'a'))
4. for each query [l, r, k]:
5.   bits = count[r+1] ^ count[l]
6.   oddCount = countSetBits(bits)
7.   return (oddCount >> 1) <= k

steps.note: Query [0, 1] with k=0. bits = count[2] ^ count[0] = 3 (binary 11)
Count set bits in 3: 2 odds found
Check (2 >> 1) <= 0 -> 1 <= 0 is false. Cannot form palindrome.
